messages.en: Have you finished yet? I'm still finishing up this assignment.
Yep. You carry on—I'll just wait for you at the library.
Where did you hide the present? I want to put the card with it too.
It's just in the cupboard in my room. Don't let Aina see it, okay?

collocations.en: make it easier to get things done

messages.en: This new form really makes our work easier, doesn't it?
Yeah, you just fill it in on your phone. No need to print it anymore.
Our little brother keeps touching that screen. He probably wants to look at the photos.
Yeah, I'll just open the photo album for him.
